Draft the next issue of **Lifetime Scope Monthly** — the biweekly LinkedIn newsletter layer of Lifetime Scope Journal (LSJ).

> **STOP — HIC approval is required before the HTML post is published.** This command produces a
> blog post, so **Non-Negotiable Rule 13** applies in full: write the issue text to
> `docs/blog-drafts/<slug>.md`, show the HIC the **complete text in one fenced code block**, and
> **stop and ask**. Publish only after they approve that post and the draft reads
> `Status: APPROVED`. Being auto-triggered by cron does not waive this — an unattended run drafts
> and waits; it never publishes. `.claude/hooks/blog-draft-gate.sh` blocks the write, and the rule
> binds even where the hook does not reach. See `docs/BLOG_STANDARD.md` §3.3 and `/blog-draft`.

**Cadence:** every 2 weeks (fortnightly). Auto-triggered on even ISO weeks by `scripts/weekly/lsj-publish-draft.sh` on DGX Spark; may also be run manually.

**Issue numbering is monotonic across all issues** regardless of cadence change (e.g. #7 was the last monthly; #8 is the first biweekly).

Usage: `/lsj-publish [<issue-number>] [<yyyy-mm-dd>]` — both arguments optional. Examples: `/lsj-publish` (auto-pick next issue number, today's date), `/lsj-publish 9` (force issue number), `/lsj-publish 9 2026-05-03` (force both). Issue number must be a bare integer ≥ 1; date must match `YYYY-MM-DD`. A token matching `YYYY-MM` (no day) is rejected as a stale monthly-era argument.

Input: $ARGUMENTS

## What it produces

Two artefacts per run:

1. **HTML blog post** at `onelifetime.world/posts/lifetime-scope-issue-<NNN>-<slug>.html` where `<NNN>` is the 3-digit zero-padded monotonic issue number and `<slug>` is a short kebab-case Best-Entry subtitle (+ synced mirror in `landing-pages/onelifetime-world/posts/`). Example: issue #8 → `lifetime-scope-issue-008-agent-native-window.html`. **Never use `<yyyy-mm>` in the filename** — biweekly cadence means two issues can land in the same month and the issue number is the only collision-safe key. Uses the existing post template + prev/next nav + share block + store cards.
2. **LinkedIn copy-paste block** — single fenced code block, no markdown, no `<>` around URLs, ready to paste into the LinkedIn newsletter composer. Follows the CLAUDE.md Copy-Paste Output Rule and Social Media Output Rule.

## Block format (fixed)

Every issue contains these blocks, in order:

1. **Issue header** — "Lifetime Scope Monthly #N — <subtitle>". Issue number is monotonic, never resets.
2. **About Lifetime Scope Journal** — 3–4 sentence intro: daily long-form at onelifetime.world/blog, EN + FI, biweekly best-of newsletter, video companion on YouTube. First paragraph of every issue (helps new subscribers).
3. **Editor's Note** — ~150 words from Risto. Thesis of the fortnight. Why this entry matters _now_.
4. **The Best Entry** — full republish of the single best LSJ post of the fortnight. Title, canonical URL, date, tags, lede paragraph, then the full body (or the first ~800 words with a "continue reading" link if the original is longer).
5. **The Runners-Up** — 3 cards (title / one-line takeaway / link to the post on onelifetime.world/blog/).
6. **Agentic Lens** — exactly one 80-word paragraph: _"If you used DWS IQ 6 agents this fortnight, here is what they found."_ Ties editorial to Alpha-Share outcomes (anonymised aggregates). Never a product pitch.
7. **Links block** — three URLs: Journal (https://onelifetime.world/blog), YouTube video companion (current: https://youtu.be/CQiREsDfsuA — refresh per issue as new videos ship), Subscribe on LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/build-relation/newsletter-follow?entityUrn=7191306524177154048). Always strip tracking params (`?si=`, `?feature=`) from YouTube URLs.
8. **Sign-off** — "Risto Anton Paarni — Editor in Chief, Lifetime Scope Journal — Lifetime Oy, Helsinki".

## Steps

1. **Parse `$ARGUMENTS`** into two optional tokens: `<issue-number>` (bare integer ≥ 1) and `<yyyy-mm-dd>` (date). Order does not matter. If `<issue-number>` is omitted, auto-derive by globbing `onelifetime.world/posts/lifetime-scope-issue-*.html`, extracting the 3-digit `NNN` from each filename, and picking `max(NNN) + 1`. If `<yyyy-mm-dd>` is omitted, default to today (UTC). **Reject a token matching `YYYY-MM` alone** (e.g. `2026-04`) with "stale monthly-era argument — pass an issue number or a full YYYY-MM-DD date" and stop.
2. **Inventory posts of the last 14 days.** Read `onelifetime.world/posts/*.html` and `onelifetime.world/posts/en/day-*.html`; filter by `<meta property="article:published_time">` within `[today - 14 days, today]` (UTC). Log the count.
3. **Rank candidates** by this priority order (matches the strategy doc at `docs/field-notes/2026-04-19-lifetime-scope-journal-media-layer-strategy.md`):
   1. Time-on-page (if analytics data available; otherwise skip)
   2. Qualified-lead attribution (if CRM hint file `data/lsj-attribution-<NNN>.json` exists — keyed by issue number; otherwise skip)
   3. Share velocity (inbound LinkedIn reshares; skip if unknown)
   4. **Editorial judgement** — differentiation, timeliness, depth, customer relevance
   Pick **one** Best Entry. Pick **three** Runners-Up.
4. **Draft Editor's Note** (~150 words). Must name the thesis, not summarise. Active voice. One sentence per idea. No adjective stacking.
5. **Draft Agentic Lens** (exactly 80 words). Must cite at least one verified outcome (Alpha-Share %, hours saved, CO2 reduced, compliance-gate passes). If no real aggregate is available, state _"No verified outcomes this fortnight — see next issue."_ Never fabricate numbers (CLAUDE.md Validated Mock Data Rule).
6. **Derive the slug** from the Best Entry's short subtitle: lowercase, kebab-case, ≤ 40 chars. Build the output filename `lifetime-scope-issue-<NNN>-<slug>.html` with `<NNN>` zero-padded to 3 digits.
7. **Generate the HTML post** at `onelifetime.world/posts/<filename>` using `onelifetime.world/posts/_template-en.html` — fill in `{{TITLE}}`, `{{DESCRIPTION}}`, `{{DATE_ISO}}`, `{{CATEGORY}}="Monthly Highlights"`, prev/next links, share block, three store cards (DWS IQ Platform €4,999 / Climate Reporting Bundle €6,500 / Firehorse Omnichannel €499 — same set used in existing LSJ posts).
8. **Sync to `landing-pages/onelifetime-world/posts/`** in the same commit (dual-folder-sync discipline skill).
9. **Update post registry** per `docs/BLOG_STANDARD.md` Section 3 — add entry, update prev/next on the neighbouring posts.
10. **Emit the LinkedIn copy-paste block** last. One fenced code block. Plain text only. URLs include `https://` protocol. No angle brackets, no backticks, no markdown link syntax. Contains: title, editor's note, link to full Best Entry on onelifetime.world, three runner-up bullets with URLs, Agentic Lens paragraph, subscribe CTA (`https://www.linkedin.com/build-relation/newsletter-follow?entityUrn=7191306524177154048`), sign-off.
11. **Commit + push** on the current branch with message `LSJ Issue #<NNN>: <Best Entry short title>`. Do not auto-post to LinkedIn — the Editor in Chief sends manually.

## Acceptance checks

- [ ] HTML validates (no unclosed tags).
- [ ] `diff onelifetime.world/posts/lifetime-scope-issue-<NNN>-<slug>.html landing-pages/onelifetime-world/posts/lifetime-scope-issue-<NNN>-<slug>.html` is empty.
- [ ] No existing file at the target path (the `<NNN>` was truly unused — collision-safe under biweekly cadence).
- [ ] Editor's Note between 120–180 words.
- [ ] Agentic Lens is exactly 80 words.
- [ ] LinkedIn block has zero `<`, `>`, backticks, or `[text](url)` markdown.
- [ ] All URLs in LinkedIn block start with `https://`.
- [ ] No fabricated metrics in Agentic Lens.

## When NOT to use

- **For any non-LSJ newsletter** — this is Lifetime Scope Monthly only.
- **Without editorial review** — always pause before the commit step to let the Editor in Chief (Risto) approve the Best Entry pick and the Editor's Note.
- **On a fortnight with < 4 published posts** — tell the user and stop. An issue needs 1 Best Entry + 3 Runners-Up (minimum 4 posts). Matches the `-lt 4` guard in `scripts/weekly/lsj-publish-draft.sh`.
- **When no real outcome aggregate exists** — the Agentic Lens must say "No verified outcomes this month" rather than invent a number. If that is unacceptable, delay the issue.
